items.label: RFID-Blocking Security
items.value: The crossbody bag features a built-in compartment with 6 RFID-blocking card slots to effectively shield radio frequency signals, protecting your credit cards and ID from electronic theft. Compact dimensions of 22×7×15.5 cm (8.7"×2.8"×6.1") offer a 2.4L capacity while weighing only 0.33 lbs (approx. 150 g)—perfect for carrying daily essentials.

items.label: Soft Leather Phone Purse
items.value: This women's crossbody handbags is crafted from soft, skin-friendly patchwork leather with a delicate touch. Its minimalist design, paired with sleek metal hardware, exudes modern simplicity. The smooth zipper ensures effortless opening and secure storage for your phone and personal items. A lightweight and versatile accessory for everyday outings.

items.label: Three-Compartment Layout
items.value: crossbody bags for women，Featuring a smart triple-compartment design, this stylish shoe-style bag keeps items neatly organized. Multiple built-in functional pockets offer quick access to essentials, while two magnetic snap pouches and a double-zipper main compartment provide practical storage for cards, coins, and small belongings. The main compartment fits phones up to 6.7 inches, cash, receipts, passports, and more.

items.label: 3-in-1 Convertible Design
items.value: Purses for women Equipped with an adjustable long strap, it can be carried as a handbag, shoulder bag, or crossbody bag. The smooth metal zipper, reinforced with double stitching, along with a front quick-access pocket, blends convenience, style, and practicality into one elegant piece.

items.label: The Perfect Choice
items.value: This versatile small crossbody purse phone bag combines fashion, functionality, and wearing comfort—ideal for outdoor activities, travel, and daily commutes. As a birthday or holiday gift for female friends and family, it’s also a thoughtful and considerate present.
